template: Production game conversation REACTION ATLAS, EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS (8 equal slots), transparent background, high resolution 4:3 sheet ideally 2048x1536. Each slot is a 2:3 standing portrait from head to mid-thigh. Keep generous transparent padding inside EACH slot; absolutely no body, fingers or accessories crossing into a neighbouring slot. TOP ROW: character A from reference 1. BOTTOM ROW: character B from reference 2. Reference 3 is ONLY a style guide: do NOT put the style-guide character in this atlas. Preserve each person's exact face, hairstyle, hair/eye colors, age, gender, distinctive outfit and accessories from their OWN reference. Use polished detailed 2D pixel-illustration portraits, crisp painted pixel clusters and expressive anime faces, not 3D voxel cubes. All figures face THREE-QUARTER LEFT and look to an off-screen conversation partner on the left. Four columns in EACH row, LEFT TO RIGHT: NEUTRAL attentive listening, JOY warm smile with modest welcoming hand gesture, CONCERN worried or sad thoughtful with hand to chest, RESOLVE quietly determined with confident gaze and a modest fist or open hand. Make facial expressions and hand/shoulder poses visibly different. Keep outfit, silhouette, anatomy, body scale, head size, head position and common bottom anchor stable through all four reactions. Fully clothed, appropriate ages, no fighting, no attack effects, no floating symbols or dramatic extra lights. NO text, labels, numbers, grid lines, UI, borders, scenery, ground or cast shadows. Exactly these two characters in four reactions each.
